dispositions.topic_text: Atomicity and ordering between give_session_csrf and concurrent session termination
Request-header and multipart-head limits, stall deadlines, cancellation, and resulting behavior
dispositions.what: The listeners' read timeout (State 2 round-90 T8): how long instance_lifecycle's listener waits for a request's bytes — an upload's head among them — before closing the connection, one value for both surfaces as a data-provider constant; a head cut by it gives no CSRF value.

dispositions.topic_text: Persistent-connection behavior when request bodies remain unread, including draining, reuse, ordering, and closure
dispositions.what: instance_lifecycle's listener: a request answered before its body was read to its end — any request, not only an upload — has its unread remainder discarded unread and its connection closed; a connection is reused only after a request whose body was read to its framed end.
